description.desc_thousand_char: Berry Global India Private Limited (BGIPL), as per its annual filings, is engaged in the business of providing drug delivery solutions in the health sector. BGIPL is engaged in the business of manufacturing drug delivery and other packaging solutions, like cups, bottles, nozzles, and caps, for its customers. It also advises customers in the design and development of the devices and molds for such devices. The company has its manufacturing facility in Sira, India. BGIPL was incorporated in 2021 and has its registered office located in Bangalore, Karnataka.
